name: werkmeister-dashboard
description: MCP App for creating sandbox multi-repo workspaces from inside Claude Desktop, delegating to the `sandbox workspace` CLI.

scripts.build:ui: cross-env INPUT=mcp-app.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=mcp-list.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=workspace-list.artifact.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=browser.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=form.html vite build
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:ui && npm run build:server
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run watch:ui" "tsx --watch src/main.ts"
scripts.test: npm run build:server && for f in test/*.smoke.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
